expert.pageDescription: Samu amsoshi nan take da jagoranci na visa ta UAE daga ƙungiyar Visatop a WhatsApp.
expert.headline: Yi magana da Ƙwararrenmu
expert.body: Faɗa mana asalin ƙasarku da kwanakin tafiyarku. Ƙwararru na visa suna amsa a WhatsApp da matakan gaba masu bayyana, farashi, da jagoranci game da takardu — babu wajibcin nema akan layi.
expert.whatsappCta: Yi hira da Ƙwararre a WhatsApp
expert.replyTime: Amsa yawanci cikin mintuna a lokacin aiki na UAE ({phone}).
expert.privacyParagraph1: Visatop ("mu") yana gudanar da wannan shafin don taimaka wa masu ziyara su tuntubi ƙungiyar tallafin visa ta WhatsApp. Lokacin da ka danna maɓallin da ke sama, kana buɗe hira da lambar kasuwancinmu ta hukuma a sabis na WhatsApp na Meta. Saƙonnin da ka aika, lambar wayarka, da kowane bayani da ka zaɓa ka raba a cikin hira ana sarrafa su domin mu amsa tambayarka kuma mu ba da taimakon da ya shafi visa.
expert.privacyParagraph2: Muna amfani da wannan bayanin kawai don sadarwa game da sabis na visa ta UAE, ƙididdiga, da tallafin nema. Ba mu sayar da bayanan sirrinku ba. Muna riƙe rikodin hira har sai an buƙata don sabis na abokin ciniki, doka, ko lissafi, sannan mu share ko mu ɓoye su inda ya dace.
expert.privacyParagraph3: Wannan shafin yana amfani da alamomin nazarin da ke kiyaye sirri don auna ko masu ziyara suna samun zaɓin WhatsApp mai amfani. Ba mu amfani da wannan shafin don bayanan talla marasa alaƙa. Don tambayoyi game da bayanan ku ko neman goge, aika imel zuwa info@visatop.com ko rubuta mana ta WhatsApp a {phone}.
